definitions: A game or contest that ends with the score even; a tie.
An act of inhaling smoke from a cigarette or pipe.
A person or thing that attracts a lot of interest or people.
The act of choosing names or numbers by chance, as in a lottery.
examples: The match ended in a 1-1 draw.
He took a long draw on his cigar.
The star performer was a huge draw.
The draw for the cup final.
